text:
gordon: Seeing a throughput regression on replay-enabled multi-GPU runs. Comm/compute overlap disappears when CUDA graphs are used with KV-cache prefetch on external streams. Repro on 8xA10G testbench.
priya: Can you paste the profiler output you have?
gordon: ```
PROFILE SNAPSHOT (tail):
[stream0] compute kernels   | 120ms
[stream1] allreduce (NCCL) | 140ms  <-- serialized after compute
graph_replay: host sync inserted between stream0 -> stream1
CPU: waiting on GPU for 0.17s
Throughput: baseline 980 tok/s -> head 830 tok/s (-15%)
```
oliver: That looks like graph-replay is suppressing cross-stream concurrency. When capture/replay sees external stream activity it can introduce implicit syncs or `cudaStreamWaitEvent` nodes.
maya: We hit something like this earlier with KV prefetch: prefetch does `cudaMemcpyAsync` on a helper stream then we launch kernels on the primary stream. If the capture didn't include the prefetch stream, replay serializes them.
ci-bot: Perf job started: https://ci.internal/perf/9672 comparing tags baseline/1.3.2 vs head/1.4.0 - preliminary shows ~15% drop on long sequences.
priya: Short list of potential fixes: 1) move KV prefetch into the same capture (capture the prefetch ops), 2) ensure stream ownership invariants during capture (disallow external-stream kernels), 3) change kernel selection so warm/colder codepaths use consistent stream flags.
gordon: I tried embedding prefetch into the captured graph: it restored overlap locally but caused a hang in multi-GPU where allreduce was scheduled on a different stream -> CI deadlock. Error snippet: ```
E: ncclAllReduce: call timed out after 120s
Stack: worker stuck waiting on graph replay completion
```
oliver: Hypothesis: kernel-selection heuristics pick a different kernel variant when KV cache is present (different shared mem / launch params). That changes node types/order during capture vs runtime, producing capture mismatch and extra event insertion. We should assert in capture path if kernel attributes change mid-capture.
maya: I'll add fine-grained tracepoints: emit when we insert `cudaStreamWaitEvent`, when `cudaGraphInstantiate` is called, and dump `cudaGraphNodeTypeKernel` ordering. I'll run with `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` + `nvprof`/`nsys` and collect timeline.
priya: I'll queue perf jobs with and without capture (and with prefetch-in-graph) and collect token-level latency breakdown from Console traces.
gordon: Action items: maya = add traces + reproduce; priya = run perf matrix and attach traces; oliver = audit kernel-selection / stream flags and add capture-time asserts; I'll open a reproducible issue with logs and minimal repro script. Thanks :thumbsup:
